title: M-PAM Demodulator Baseband
text: 解调 M-PAM 调制数据，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型 Inherit via internal；{M-ary number} 指定调制阶数、{Output type} 输出类型 Integer、{Constellation ordering} 指定符号的映射顺序、{Normalization method} 指定星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between、{Minimum distance} 指定两个最近星座点之间的距离、{Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定平均功率、{Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定最大功率、{Denormalization factor} 指定反归一化因子数据类型、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Sum} 指定求和数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: M-PAM 调制信号 scalar | column vector

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: 调制阶数 4 (default) | positive, even integer

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: 符号的映射顺序 Binary (default) | Gray

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: 两个最近星座点之间的距离 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Denormalization factor
params.values: 反归一化因子数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Wrap (default) | Saturate

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Sum
params.values: 求和数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16) |
